layout_and_spacing.strategy: Dense grid bento layout for news, strict tabular layouts for transfer data.

components.header: bg-[#053f2c] text-white border-b-4 border-[#00a651] sticky top-0 z-50
components.table_header: bg-[#f4f4f5] p-3 border-b border-border font-bold uppercase text-xs

ad_management.slots: Include multiple fixed-size ad containers (e.g. 728x90 leaderboard, 300x250 rectangle). Immediately render a placeholder with bg-gray-100 and a subtle 'Anzeige' label to prevent cumulative layout shift.

hero_stadium.description: Aerial view of a football stadium, used for general backgrounds or competition pages.

action_player_1.description: Player running, used for news placeholders or player profile defaults.

stadium_fans.description: Packed stadium with fans, used for club pages or match day news.

interactions.hover: Subtle background color shifts, borders changing to primary green. Example: hover:bg-[#f4f4f5] hover:border-[#00a651]

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='nav-news-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: Update Tailwind configuration with the custom colors defined above. Ensure forms use green focus rings.
Implement Shadcn tabs for Player/Club profile views and dense data tables for the 'Bestätigte Transfers' section.
Add a Marquee for 'Breaking News/Live-Ticker' placed below the main header.
Develop the Admin Dashboard with strict modular grids for adcode management, news content generation, and transfer event tracking.
Do NOT use lazy loading for Ad slots to ensure immediate impression tracking.
